$comment: Launch profile hash vectors shared by the relay and the Firmary Helper (src/ai-relay/relay-crypto.ts `launchProfileHash`; Helper protocol.ProfileHash, slice L2). profileHash is lower-case hex SHA-256 over the ASCII bytes `firmary-launch-profile-v1`, then the profile's UTF-8 byte length as an 8-byte big-endian integer, then those bytes: the same recipe as promptHash with one field and its own domain separation. `profile` is the decoded JSON string value of the `turn` message's `profile` field, hashed exactly as received and never re-serialised, so the same JSON value spelled differently hashes differently. Values were computed with Go 1.24 (crypto/sha256, encoding/binary.BigEndian) and the TypeScript implementation is tested against them. Every `profile` here also parses as a valid LaunchProfile (launch-profile.schema.json). The Helper copies this file into internal/protocol/testdata.

profileHash.name: Claude Code turn with web search
same JSON value spelled with spaces hashes differently
same JSON value with keys reordered hashes differently
non-ASCII text hashes as raw UTF-8 bytes
